name: xlsx
description: Read and edit .xlsx workbooks in the task's sandbox — sheets, cell ranges with both formulas and values, search, and targeted cell writes.

tools.name: list_sheets
tools.description: List a workbook's sheets, with the extent of each.

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read cells, with both their formulas and their computed values.

tools.name: find_cells
tools.description: Find cells whose value or formula contains a string.

tools.name: write_cells
tools.description: Set specific cells in an existing workbook, leaving the rest alone.
